scanNote:
WORKBOOK 12-UNITNING TO'RTINChI (oxirgi) BETI (53-bet, PDF 51). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Holidays with a Difference' va to'q sariq '12'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Reading':
14) 'Read the postcard and look at the pictures. Which of the pictures do not match the information given in the postcard?' 7 SURAT: A syorfing; B qahva ichayotgan ayol (balkonda); C sohil (havodan); D tennis korti; E dengiz mahsulotlari; F balkon (manzara); G chang'ichi. OTKRITKA: 'Dear Sally, We're having a fantastic time in beautiful Honolulu, Hawaii, in the middle of the Pacific Ocean. The guest house we are staying at is lovely and our room has got a balcony with a spectacular view. The weather is marvellous. At the moment, I am relaxing and having a cup of coffee. Dave is surfing. You know how crazy he is about surfing! Hawaii is a really wonderful place to spend a holiday. The seafood here is absolutely delicious and the nightclubs are full of life till the early hours of the morning! I'd better go now. See you in two weeks! Love, Amy'

O'NG USTUN - 'Writing (a holiday postcard)':
15a) 'Match the prompts to the pictures below.' 1 I listen/Italian songs; 2 mum/dad/sit/pool/sunbathe; 3 Rome/capital/Italy; 4 city/full of/interesting monuments; 5 we/stay/guest house; 6 food/delicious/we try/different/pasta dish/every day; 7 I/have/cup of coffee; 8 hot/sunny/weather/be. RASMLAR: a basseyn bo'yida soyabon ostida juftlik; b mehmon uyi; c ko'zoynakli quyosh; d makaron (spagetti); e bir piyola qahva; f Italiya xaritasi (Rome); g Kolizey va ustunlar; h magnitofon.
15b) 'Use the plan and the prompts to write a postcard to your friend (50 - 100 words). Use the postcard in Ex. 14 as a model.' PLAN: Para 1: where you are on holiday & where you are staying; Para 2: the weather, what you are doing at the moment, who you are with & what they are doing at the moment; Para 3: your impressions of the place and the food; Para 4: closing remarks.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '53'.
⚠ Orqa tomondan (54-bet, 'Join in the Fun!') sarlavha ko'chib ko'rinadi.

exercises.instructionEn: Dear Sally, ... Love, Amy (postcard from Honolulu, Hawaii)
exercises.instructionUz: Aziz Salli, ... Mehr bilan, Emi (Gonolulu, Gavayidan otkritka)
exercises.explanationUz:
TA'TIL OTKRITKASI (coursebook
  84-bet 10-mashq bilan bir xil
  qolip).

TUZILISh (4 xatboshi):
  1 Qayerda + turar joy
  2 Ob-havo + hozir nima qilyapman
    + kim bilan, u nima qilyapti
  3 Joy va ovqat haqida taassurot
  4 Yakuniy so'zlar


⚠ HONOLULU:

  = Gonolulu - Gavayi poytaxti,
  Tinch okean o'rtasida.


⚠ 'SPECTACULAR':

  = hayratlanarli (manzara).


⚠ 'MARVELLOUS':

  = ajoyib (Brit. ikki 'l').


⚠ 'CRAZY ABOUT':

  = ... ga jinni, ishqiboz.


⚠ 'FULL OF LIFE':

  = jonli, gavjum.


⚠ 'TILL THE EARLY HOURS':

  = tonggacha.


⚠ 'I'D BETTER GO NOW':

  = endi borishim kerak (xat
  yakuni).

exercises.instructionUz: Ko'rsatmalarni quyidagi rasmlarga moslang. 1 I listen/Italian songs 2 mum/dad/sit/pool/sunbathe 3 Rome/capital/Italy 4 city/full of/interesting monuments 5 we/stay/guest house 6 food/delicious/we try/different/pasta dish/every day 7 I/have/cup of coffee 8 hot/sunny/weather/be. Rasmlar: a basseyn bo'yida soyabon ostidagi juftlik; b mehmon uyi; c ko'zoynakli quyosh; d makaron; e bir piyola qahva; f Italiya xaritasi (Rim); g Kolizey; h magnitofon.
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'RSATMA → RASM → GAP.

  1 → h (magnitofon): I'm listening
    to Italian songs.
  2 → a (basseyn): Mum and Dad are
    sitting by the pool and
    sunbathing.
  3 → f (xarita): Rome is the
    capital of Italy.
  4 → g (Kolizey): The city is full
    of interesting monuments.
  5 → b (uy): We are staying at a
    guest house.
  6 → d (makaron): The food is
    delicious and we try a
    different pasta dish every day.
  7 → e (qahva): I'm having a cup
    of coffee.
  8 → c (quyosh): The weather is
    hot and sunny.


⚠ 'TO SUNBATHE':

  = quyoshda toblanmoq.


⚠ 'A PASTA DISH':

  = makaron taomi.

modelAnswers:
Dear Sally,

We're having a wonderful time in Rome, the capital of Italy. We are staying at a lovely guest house near the city centre.

The weather is hot and sunny. At the moment, I'm having a cup of coffee and listening to Italian songs. Mum and Dad are sitting by the pool and sunbathing.

Rome is a really beautiful city, full of interesting monuments. The food is delicious and we try a different pasta dish every day!

I'd better go now. See you next week!

Love,
Aziz
modelAnswersUz:
Aziz Salli,

Biz Italiya poytaxti Rimda ajoyib vaqt o'tkazyapmiz. Shahar markazi yaqinidagi chiroyli mehmon uyida turibmiz.

Ob-havo issiq va quyoshli. Hozir men qahva ichib, italyan qo'shiqlarini tinglayapman. Oyim va dadam basseyn bo'yida o'tirib toblanishyapti.

Rim chindan go'zal shahar, qiziqarli yodgorliklarga to'la. Ovqat mazali va biz har kuni boshqa makaron taomini tatib ko'ryapmiz!

Endi borishim kerak. Kelasi hafta ko'rishamiz!

Mehr bilan,
Aziz
